<?php
class QuietStringRead {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return $incoming !== "skip"; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): string {
        echo "G;";
        if ($incoming === "zero") { return 0; }
        return "q\0";
    }
}
function quietStringRhs(): int { echo "RHS;"; return 9; }
$receiver = new QuietStringRead;
$selector = "zero";
echo empty($receiver->$selector) ? "EMPTY_ZERO;" : "BAD_ZERO;";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietStringRhs()) === "0" ? "STRING_ZERO;" : "BAD_STRING;";
$selector = "q";
echo empty($receiver->$selector) ? "BAD_NUL_EMPTY;" : "NONEMPTY_NUL;";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietStringRhs()) === "q\0" ? "NUL_BYTES;" : "BAD_NUL;";
echo ($receiver->skip ?? quietStringRhs()) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD_FALL;";
echo $selector === "q" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class QuietStringAssign {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): string { echo "G;"; return ""; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BAD_SET;"; }
}
function quietStringAssignRhs(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$receiver = new QuietStringAssign;
echo ($receiver->value ??= quietStringAssignRhs()) === "" ? "EMPTY_KEEP;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";
